post.content:
A sad spy, a ghost who walks through walls, a guy with a shield, a dad in a too-small suit... and a man called Bob who can fly. Nobody planned this team. 😅

This is Thunderbolts*, DUMBED DOWN: a funny cartoon recap for Marvel fans of all ages. The trap in the vault, the fire escape, the cucumber climb, the limo chase, the Sentry, the Void, the group hug, and what that little star in the title really means.

⚠️ Spoilers for the whole movie, including the ending.
